weekly_theme.summary: 水星目前正在逆行（落在天蠍座，10/24–11/13），這段時間適合放慢腳步、重新確認訊息，避免倉促簽約或做重大決定。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，阻礙您最渴望實現的抱負的挑戰可能會出乎意料地消失，為您的夢想鋪平道路。這可能與您的身體健康、對旅行和學習的渴望，以及您的創造性表達有關。此外，您此時的激情高漲，與那位特別的人共度浪漫夜晚會特別愉快。您感覺非常好，所以別忘了展現出最好的自己！
aries.horoscope_en: Challenges that have stood in the way of your most desired ambitions may unexpectedly dissipate, paving the path for your dreams to unfold, Aries. This could relate to your physical well-being, aspirations for travel and learning, as well as your creative expression. Additionally, your passion is heightened at this time, making a romantic evening with that special person particularly delightful. You're feeling fantastic, so don’t forget to present your best self!

taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, expect a flurry of happenings around your home. You might welcome guests or tackle some home improvement projects. Your intuition is heightened, making you sensitive to the emotions and thoughts of those around you, including unfamiliar faces. You'll likely feel a deep connection with your family. Be mindful of your thoughts, as they hold the power to manifest into reality.

gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you might find that the aspirations you've been pursuing are on the verge of coming to fruition. While you may need to dash around town and engage with various individuals to tie up loose ends, the excitement of it all is likely to invigorate you. Influential figures could offer significant support, enhancing your progress. Embrace this positive momentum and seize the opportunity!

cancer.horoscope_en: Cancer, it appears that circumstances beyond your influence are aligning to bring about positive changes in your life. While this may feel a bit unsettling, try not to let it overwhelm you. Embrace the current of events. You've put in the effort to reach this point, and now it's time to relish the fruits of your labor. The excitement you experience may translate into a surge of physical vitality, but be cautious—too much enthusiasm can lead to overexertion.

leo.horoscope_en: Today, your vitality is likely at an all-time high, Leo—so much so that you might feel ready to tackle a marathon! It's a great day for you to consider a little getaway or adventure. Engaging in physical activities or individual sports could be particularly enticing. You may also find yourself channeling this abundant energy into creative endeavors. Just remember to pace yourself; it's easy to push too hard and end up feeling drained.

virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, your inner strength is likely peaking today, filling you with a sense of confidence. You'll find that your ability to sway those around you is heightened. Your mind is exceptionally alert, making it an ideal time to dive into new learning experiences that will enrich you. Additionally, your creative juices are flowing, so consider dedicating time to artistic endeavors. As the evening approaches, a wave of romance will wash over you—perfect for arranging a cozy evening with someone special!

It's essential to focus your thoughts on positivity and beauty, as you may discover that your mindset has the power to bring your desires to life! Expect some vivid dreams and enlightening visions that could lead you down exciting new paths of intellectual discovery, potentially shaping your near future in significant ways. Embrace this energy!

While this might feel unusual and even a little daunting, your inner strength is particularly potent right now, allowing your higher self to bring forth the fruits of your labor. In moments like these, it's essential to reflect on those who supported you throughout your journey. Be sure to express gratitude to both them and yourself.
